sections.content:
You know the past tense from Unit 24. *Kell* has a past form too, **kellett** (3rd person singular), and the person stays on the infinitive:
- *Mennem kell* (I must go) → **Mennem kellett** (I had to go).
- *Korán kellett kelnem.* = I had to wake up early.
- *Nem kellett sokat várnunk.* = We didn't have to wait a lot.
- *Érdemes volt megnéznetek a kiállítást.* = It was worth you seeing the exhibition.

items.spanish: Tegnap sokáig kellett dolgoznom az irodában.
items.english: Yesterday I had to work late in the office.

items.spanish: Nem kellett fizetnünk a parkolásért hétvégén.
items.english: We didn't have to pay for parking on the weekend.

items.spanish: Nehéz volt időben befejeznie a feladatot.
items.english: It was difficult for him to finish the task on time.
